title: Payments Desk Questions and Answers: Automatic Debit and the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Fee
content:
**Rule.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee carries an automatic-debit credit: 20.00 is taken off when the loan's installments are collected by automatic debit and the loan carries no returned payment dated less than 12 whole months before the grant; 20.00 is added when they are collected by automatic debit and the loan carries such a returned payment; and nothing when the loan is not on automatic debit. The amount is applied to the deferral fee after every multiplication of the fee has been made; the total is rounded once to cents and is never less than zero.

**What shows whether the loan is on automatic debit?**
The loan record's autopay enrolment.

**What counts as a returned payment?**
A principal or interest payment return entry on the loan, dated less than 12 whole months before the grant.

**What amount applies?**

| Installments collected by automatic debit | Returned payment within 12 whole months | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | -20.00 |
| yes | yes | 20.00 added |
| no | either | 0 |

**Does a returned payment matter when the loan is not on automatic debit?**
No; without automatic debit nothing is added or taken off.
